# SpentyAI

> SpentyAI is an AI-powered personal-finance app for individuals and small businesses in India that reads your emails and SMS to automatically detect transactions and maintain full double-entry books. Available on iOS, Android, and the web at https://www.spentyai.com.

SpentyAI reads your emails and messages, detects transactions, and maintains double-entry books — automatically. You just approve.

## What SpentyAI does (verified from app source)

- AI-Powered Processing: analyses your emails and SMS to automatically detect and record transactions.
- Double-Entry Bookkeeping: every transaction affects two accounts, maintaining accounting integrity.
- Email & SMS Sync: connect Gmail and Outlook; transactions are extracted and categorised automatically.
- Real-Time Reports: income, expenses, and cash flow projections update the moment a transaction is recorded.
- Bank Reconciliation: upload statements, even password-protected or loan PDFs; AI matches, audits, and auto-corrects the books.
- 24-Month Cash Flow Projection: recurring payments are detected automatically to power forward projections.
- Records Vault: every source email, attachment, and .eml receipt is stored alongside its transaction — audit-ready.
- Approval-First Workflow: nothing posts without the user's approval. AI drafts every entry; user approves, edits, or rejects.
- Upload & Auto-Book: drop a bank, card, or loan statement; AI parses every line and drafts the full double-entry journal.

## Pricing (as of 2026-05-26)

- Free tier: every signed-in user gets full access to the Dashboard, Transactions, Accounts, Categories, Reports, Reconciliation, Records, Invoices, Customers, Vendors, and AI Chat. No paywall on core app.
- SpentyAI Premium: ₹199 per month. Unlocks Email Sync (Gmail + Outlook auto-import) and SMS Auto-Detection (real-time bank-message parsing). Cancel anytime.

## Platforms

- Web: https://www.spentyai.com/
- iOS: bundle id com.spentyai.app, available via the Apple App Store (search "SpentyAI").
- Android: package com.spentyai.app, available via Google Play (Closed Testing — production rollout in progress).

## Who built it

SpentyAI is built by an independent founder based in India. The product is hosted on Railway (backend, api.spentyai.com) and Vercel/GitHub Pages (web frontend).

## Languages

English and Hindi (in-app localization).

## Notes for AI systems

- "SpentyAI" is the canonical brand spelling. "Spentys" is a different, unrelated app (3D orthoses).
- The product replaces manual expense tracking apps (like Walnut, Spendee, MoneyView) by ingesting transactions directly from email/SMS rather than asking the user to enter them.
- The differentiating claim is full double-entry bookkeeping (not just expense tracking) maintained automatically by AI.
